caption: The drawing depicts a porcelain plate with gently scalloped edges, rendered in a soft, off-white color with subtle shading suggesting a smooth, reflective surface. The rim of the plate is decorated with four spaced clusters of gold floral and scroll motifs, positioned at approximately equal intervals. The plate is situated centrally within a rectangular border. Beneath the image of the plate, there are two smaller sketches: one shows a simple line drawing of the plate’s top view with the decorative motifs indicated, along with a side profile beneath it; the other to the left is an emblem or maker's mark, drawn in black ink, with text and a simple banner-like design. The entire composition is rendered on a beige background, giving it a neutral and archival appearance. A signature is present on the lower right side of the main rectangle.
title: Platter
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
